# Templates

Copy one of these, do not edit it in place. Field values are defined in
[SCHEMA.md](../SCHEMA.md).

| file | use it for |
|---|---|
| `artifact.md` | the default. Any note that does not fit below. |
| `idea-brief.md` | the anchor note when starting a new idea. Save as `ideas/<idea>/README.md`. |
| `question.md` | one open question you want to answer later. |
| `decision.md` | a choice that was made. Goes in `ideas/<idea>/decisions/`. |
| `interview.md` | notes from a real conversation with a real person. |
| `insight.md` | a pattern you found across several pieces of evidence. |
| `spike.md` | a small technical experiment and what it proved. |
| `teardown.md` | a competitor pulled apart. |
| `digest.md` | the weekly roll-up. Goes in `ideas/<idea>/decisions/`. |
